_: Typical ranges are what the explorer's constitution samples. They are NOT limits. A studio patch may leave them; it may never leave the gamut.

contracts.T4: outside the constitution - reported, not refused

fields.does: Hue of the last two stops, 0-360. The organism reads as two hue families meeting; the distance between this and baseHueDeg is how far apart they read.
fields.name: accentHueDeg

fields.does: Multiplies saturation for the accent stops, 0-1. Below 1 the accent is the quieter half.
fields.name: accentSaturationScale

fields.does: Opacity of the back membrane, 0-1. Raising it toward frontAlpha makes the two read as separate sheets.
fields.name: backAlpha

fields.does: Size of the second membrane relative to the front one, 0-1.5.
fields.name: backScale

fields.does: Hue of the organism's first two palette stops, 0-360. 0 red, 120 green, 210 blue, 280 violet, 330 pink.
fields.name: baseHueDeg

fields.does: A soft warm glow added at the lit edges, 0-1.
fields.name: bloom

fields.does: Exposure of the finished image, 0-3. Above about 1.8 pale palettes blow out to white.
fields.name: brightness

fields.does: Curl along the sheet's length, about -2 to 2.
fields.name: curl

fields.does: A steady directional drift, 0-1, so the motion has a direction to come from.
fields.name: currentStrength

fields.does: How far the sheet extends away from the viewer, 0-1.5.
fields.name: depth

fields.does: Low-frequency waviness of the outer edge, 0-0.5.
fields.name: edgeFlutter

fields.does: High-frequency frilling of the outer edge, 0-1. Zero is a smooth hem.
fields.name: edgeRuffle

fields.does: How far out of frame the organism has travelled. 0 is present; 7-13 is gone, leaving the ground as the picture.
fields.name: exitDistance

fields.does: Fine flutter along the edge, 0-1.
fields.name: fineFlutter

fields.does: Number of folds across the sheet. More folds means more of the sheet crossing itself, which deepens colour where it overlaps.
fields.name: foldDensity

fields.does: Light gathering along folds, 0-3. This is what reads as sheen on cloth.
fields.name: foldHighlight

fields.does: Opacity of the front membrane, 0-1.
fields.name: frontAlpha

fields.does: Shifts where the palette sits across the form, about -0.5 to 0.5.
fields.name: gradientPosition

fields.does: Saturation applied to the finished image, 0-3.
fields.name: gradingSaturation

fields.does: Horizontal centre of the ground gradient, 0-1.
fields.name: groundCenterX

fields.does: Vertical centre of the ground gradient, 0-1.
fields.name: groundCenterY

fields.does: Hue of the ground's middle stop, 0-360. The ground is three stops: this minus half the spread, this, this plus half the spread.
fields.name: groundHueDeg

fields.does: How far the ground's two end stops sit either side of the middle hue. Small is one colour; 150+ crosses the wheel.
fields.name: groundHueSpreadDeg

fields.does: Lightness of the first ground stop, 0-1. The deeper of the two ends wins the frame.
fields.name: groundLightnessA

fields.does: Lightness of the last ground stop, 0-1.
fields.name: groundLightnessB

fields.does: Where the middle stop's lightness sits between A and B, 0-1. Hue is unaffected.
fields.name: groundMidBias

fields.does: Colour strength of the ground, 0-1. Under about 0.2 the ground reads as paper.
fields.name: groundSaturation

fields.does: Direction the ground gradient runs, 0-360.
fields.name: groundSweepAngleDeg

fields.does: Darkening toward the corners, 0-1. Small values read photographic.
fields.name: groundVignette

fields.does: Colour-channel rotation at edges and folds, 0-1. At 1 the edges go rainbow.
fields.name: iridescence

fields.does: Darkest palette stop, 0-1. Where folds fall to.
fields.name: lightness0

fields.does: Second stop, 0-1.
fields.name: lightness1

fields.does: Third stop, 0-1.
fields.name: lightness2

fields.does: Lightest stop, 0-1. Where the light catches, and what metallic mode mixes toward.
fields.name: lightness3

fields.does: Fine grain across the surface, 0-1.
fields.name: membraneGrain

fields.does: Fine folding on top of the main folds, 0-1.
fields.name: microFold

fields.does: Which colour treatment the shader uses: 0 plain, 1 koi, 2 pearl-red, 3 alternate gradient, 4 ridge tint (sheen along folds), 5 metallic (mixes toward lightness3 by fresnel).
fields.name: morphMode

fields.does: How far the sheet travels as it moves, 0-1.
fields.name: motionAmplitude

fields.does: Speed of the whole animation, 0-1. Slow means low speed with high amplitude - one long travelling wave.
fields.name: motionSpeed

fields.does: How much the surface's fine relief catches light, 0-1.
fields.name: normalDetail

fields.does: How much of the surface is there at all, strictly between 0 and 1. This is the main translucency dial.
fields.name: opacity

fields.does: How far out of step the two membranes are, 0-60. Large values stop them reading as one doubled edge.
fields.name: phaseOffset

fields.does: How oversized the organism is. The rule is dominant or departed: it should fill the frame and leave it, never sit small in the middle.
fields.name: presenceScale

fields.does: How many rays the membrane is built from. Low counts leave visible teeth along a silhouette; high counts read as a fine hem.
fields.name: rayCount

fields.does: How distinct each ray is, 0-1.
fields.name: rayDefinition

fields.does: Light gathering along edges, 0-3.
fields.name: rimStrength

fields.does: Colour strength of the base stops, 0-1. Note it has little authority where transmission is high.
fields.name: saturation

fields.does: How differently the second membrane is shaped, 0-20.
fields.name: seedOffset

fields.does: How far the membrane fans open, in radians up to about 2pi. Wide values reach both edges of the frame.
fields.name: spread

fields.does: How much light passes through, strictly between 0 and 1. High transmission means the ground behind drives the colour.
fields.name: transmission

fields.does: Irregularity of the motion, 0-1. Wind is a little irregular; water is not.
fields.name: turbulence

fields.does: Twist about the body axis, about -2 to 2.
fields.name: twist

fields.does: Visible veining through the membrane, 0-1. Veins read as living tissue rather than cloth.
fields.name: veinStrength

notes: A patch sets only the fields it names. An omitted field keeps the value the seed gave it - there is no way to say 'none', only a value.

Where transmission is high, palette saturation has very little authority: the visible colour is mostly the ground seen through the sheet. To deepen a translucent colour, raise foldDensity so the sheet overlaps itself more, or darken the ground.

A silhouette seen nearly edge-on shows the ray tips as teeth. edgeRuffle, edgeFlutter and fineFlutter do not remove them; raising rayCount well past the constitution's range makes them fine enough to read as a hem.
opacity and transmission must both stay strictly inside 0 and 1 or contract T3 fails: fully opaque or fully invisible is a broken picture, not a style.
The four palette lightness stops must span at least 0.08 (T5), and the two ground lightnesses at least 0.05 (T6).
The crop is never yours to set. The eight locked compositions belong to the owner and the studio only chooses among them.
A patch may leave the constitution's typical ranges - that is the studio's purpose - but every value must stay in gamut: hues 0-360, all saturations and lightnesses 0-1.

parts._: Optional. Replaces the rigid parts accompanying the membrane.
